description: Reconcile a lawyer's client trust (IOLTA) account three ways as of a date: the adjusted bank balance, the trust account's general ledger (journal) balance, and the total of the client ledgers. Send the bank statement balance, the deposits in transit, outstanding checks and any other bank credits or deductions not yet on the statement, the general ledger balance, and each client ledger's balance by code. Get back the three balances, whether they are identical, each difference, every client ledger below zero (one client's money covering another's), outstanding items older than the age you set, and hints for finding a difference (a single item, an item entered with the wrong sign, a transposed figure). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/trust-three-way-reconciliation). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

as_of.description: Reporting date (the bank statement's ending date), YYYY-MM-DD.

bank_statement_balance.description: Ending balance on the bank statement.

client_ledgers.description: Every client ledger with a balance (up to 200), plus the administrative ledger if you keep one.

balance.description: Ledger balance as of the date (below 0 if overdrawn).

ledger.description: Client or matter ledger code (with at least one digit, such as C-0042; up to 8 digits in a row, letters only as abbreviations up to 4), or ADMIN for the administrative ledger (the lawyer's own funds kept for bank charges). Not a client name.

deposits_in_transit.description: Deposits recorded in the ledger but not yet on the statement (up to 200; an empty list if none).

date.description: Optional date written or deposited, YYYY-MM-DD (on or before as_of).

ref.description: Check number or deposit reference with at least one digit (up to 8 digits in a row, letters only as abbreviations up to 4), not a payee or client name.

general_ledger_balance.description: Trust account balance in the general ledger (trust journal or checkbook) as of the date.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'IOLTA October' (your own text, echoed; no account number).

other_credits.description: Other credits to add to the statement balance (up to 200), as your reconciliation lists them.

date.description: Optional date written or deposited, YYYY-MM-DD (on or before as_of).

ref.description: Check number or deposit reference with at least one digit (up to 8 digits in a row, letters only as abbreviations up to 4), not a payee or client name.

other_deductions.description: Other deductions to subtract from the statement balance (up to 200), as your reconciliation lists them.

date.description: Optional date written or deposited, YYYY-MM-DD (on or before as_of).

ref.description: Check number or deposit reference with at least one digit (up to 8 digits in a row, letters only as abbreviations up to 4), not a payee or client name.

outstanding_checks.description: Checks and transfers recorded in the ledger but not yet cleared (up to 200; an empty list if none).

date.description: Optional date written or deposited, YYYY-MM-DD (on or before as_of).

ref.description: Check number or deposit reference with at least one digit (up to 8 digits in a row, letters only as abbreviations up to 4), not a payee or client name.

stale_days.description: Optional: list dated outstanding items (checks and deposits) older than this many days at as_of.
